The structure of Lu6Al4Co4 (reduced formula Lu3(AlCo)2) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Immm (No. 216), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. CrystalNN geometry-only analysis shows Al and Co centers each coordinated by nine neighbors, while Lu centers have 16 neighbors; the geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 14 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Al and Co 9-vertex polyhedra, and corner, edge, and face sharing among Lu 16-vertex polyhedra.
